name: com.uforce.fpv-flight
description: Betaflight-like FPV flight core for Unity: acro and angle modes, RC rate / super rate / expo, motor lag, quadratic drag, battery sag, a wind interface, a radio link interface with Betaflight failsafe, and Radiomaster TX12 input with calibration. No Mirror, Zenject, HUD or UI dependencies.

samples.description: Demo input actions (TX12, gamepad, keyboard), default profiles, a demo flight driver, a telemetry overlay and a demo scene builder.
Drone type presets: a strike FPV and two interceptors, each as airframe, battery and rates assets.
